controls: request policy, exact Host/Origin, body length, JSON duplicate-key and constant rejection
session authentication, exact operation capability, mutation CSRF
free-form service error text removed from HTTP responses
no-store, nosniff, no-referrer and CSP response headers; no CORS

tests.focused_command: python3 -m unittest tests.test_management_http_adapter tests.test_management_request_policy tests.test_management_sessions tests.test_management_authorization -v

limitations: The adapter is an in-process handler, not a TCP listener; no real socket, browser, or on-device loopback test was performed.
Mutation replay state is lost on process restart; mutation routes therefore remain disabled by default.
Durable sanitized audit, bounded server workers/deadlines, and listener lifecycle/recovery remain open.
The existing application service still accepts only its trusted local CLI caller; the adapter invokes it only after in-process session authorization.
